title: Landing Page by @samgrosss: Super happy to finally introduce Audyr and officially open the waitlis
notes:
Super happy to finally introduce Audyr and officially open the waitlist! Audyr helps product teams turn messy user feedback into clear, actionable insights. > Groups similar feedback automatically > Spots trends and user sentiment > Helps you decide what to build next > Sends insights to the tools you already use (Notion, Jira, Linear) > Easy widget to collect feedback from users I’ve spoken to so many founders who struggle to truly understand what users want, and how to build it the right way. Audyr helps with exactly that. If this sounds familiar join the waitlist & learn more at audyr . com

Designer: @samgrosss. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
